_note: Curated code recipes for catalogue substitute edges, written by hand for Bharat Sourcer on 2026-10-09. Each recipe implements the `code` changes of one edge in data/parts_catalog.json for the named library only; other changes stay notes. Recipes are deterministic text edits applied outside comments and strings; a required step that matches nothing, or more than max_matches places, refuses the whole recipe instead of guessing, and so does a refuse_if step that finds a form the recipe cannot change safely. Recipes for the BME280/BMP180 → BMP280, WS2812B → SK6812 RGBW and DS1307 ↔ DS3231 edges were added on 2026-10-10 from a 2026-10-09 draft. A curated patch is not compiled or tested on hardware.

implements: Swap Adafruit_SSD1306 for Adafruit_SH110X: Adafruit_SH1106G display(128, 64, &Wire, -1); display.begin(0x3C, true); SSD1306_WHITE becomes SH110X_WHITE. Drawing calls (Adafruit GFX) are unchanged.

steps.describe: Include Adafruit_SH110X.h instead of Adafruit_SSD1306.h
Display object Adafruit_SSD1306 → Adafruit_SH1106G (same width, height, Wire and reset arguments)
begin(SSD1306_SWITCHCAPVCC, addr) → begin(addr, true)
Colour constant SSD1306_WHITE → SH110X_WHITE
Colour constant SSD1306_BLACK → SH110X_BLACK
Colour constant SSD1306_INVERSE → SH110X_INVERSE
Old colour names BLACK, WHITE, INVERSE (defined by Adafruit_SSD1306.h, not by SH110X) → SH110X_ names
SSD1306 names left after the swap (a second display object, SSD1306_LCDHEIGHT or other constants SH110X does not have)
PlatformIO / library dependency Adafruit SSD1306 → Adafruit SH110X

implements: STEP high and low must each last at least 1.9 µs: call stepper.setMinPulseWidth(2) (AccelStepper) and check delayMicroseconds(1) loops.

steps.insert: {indent}{var}.setMinPulseWidth(2);  // DRV8825: STEP pulses of at least 1.9 µs

implements: Use NEO_GRBW instead of NEO_GRB in the Adafruit_NeoPixel constructor. FastLED's usual addLeds() sends three bytes per LED, so FastLED sketches show wrong colours until they use RGBW output or switch to Adafruit_NeoPixel.

steps.describe: FastLED strips, or a colour order other than NEO_GRB (choose the RGBW order by hand)
Two-argument Adafruit_NeoPixel(count, pin), which defaults to NEO_GRB → add NEO_GRBW + NEO_KHZ800
Pixel type NEO_GRB → NEO_GRBW
An Adafruit_NeoPixel declared without a pixel type (empty or one-argument constructor)
